name: Texas 42
description: Texas 42 is a four-player partnership trick-taking game using a double-six domino set (28 tiles). Each draws 7; bid 30â€“42 (points the team will take). High bidder names trump (blanks, 1sâ€“6s, doubles, or no-trump) and leads. Follow suit; else any tile. 42 points per hand: 1 per trick plus count tiles (5-5 and 6-4 = 10 each; 5-0, 4-1, 3-2 = 5 each). Meet bid to score; else opponents get bid plus points. First to 250 (or 7 marks) wins.

history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: USA (Texas)
Time Period: 1887
Historical Development: Invented in Trapp Spring (now Garner), Parker County, Texas, by William Thomas (12) and Walter Earl (14) as a domino alternative to card games; spread across Texas via families and communities; soldiers took it overseas in WWII.
Cultural Significance: Designated State Domino Game of Texas (2011); played in homes, churches, clubs, and tournaments.
timeline: 1887: Game invented in Trapp Spring/Garner, Texas
Early 1900s: Spread across Texas via Thomas and Earl families
1940s: Played statewide; Texas soldiers spread it overseas
2011: Designated State Domino Game of Texas

setup.players: 4 players in fixed partnerships; players sit opposite their partner.
setup.deck: Double-six set of dominoes (28 tiles, one for each pair from 0 to 6).
setup.dealing: Dealer shuffles face down; each player takes 7 dominoes (opponents first, then partner, then dealer). Deal rotates clockwise.
setup.equipment: Double-six domino set; score sheet or marks (e.g. drawn to form ALL).

rules.objective: Be the first player to achieve the winning condition through strategic play of cards.
rules.gameplay:
1. Setup: Deal cards to all players
2. Gameplay: Players take turns playing cards
3. Scoring: Points awarded based on game outcomes
4. Winning: First to reach target score or complete objective wins

strategy.basic: Texas 42: follow rules; strategy depends on variant.

variations.name: No Trump (Follow Me)
variations.description: High bidder may play without trumps; doubles high or doubles low.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Engine overrides not yet specified for this variant.

variations.name: Doubles trump
variations.description: Bidder can choose doubles as trumps; doubles form a separate suit ranking 6-6 to 0-0.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Engine overrides not yet specified for this variant.

variations.name: Nello
variations.description: Contract to lose every trick; declarer's partner sits out; no trumps; doubles form own suit.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Engine overrides not yet specified for this variant.

variations.name: Plunge
variations.description: Declarer must have 4+ doubles; partner names trump and declarer leads; must take all 7 tricks. Bid 4+ marks.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Engine overrides not yet specified for this variant.

variations.name: Sevens
variations.description: Each player plays tile with pip total closest to 7; declarer's team must take all 7 tricks.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Engine overrides not yet specified for this variant.

scoring.description: 42 points per hand (1 per trick plus count tiles). Make bid to score marks; if set, opponents score. First to 7 marks wins.
scoring.winCondition: First partnership to reach 7 marks wins the game.
